name: script_aischedule_walk
about: An aiscripted_schedule pushes a walk order and nothing else. sm_hub_1's blue_blood_to_alley (m_iszEntity SMblueblood, m_flRadius 128, schedule 1, forcestate 0, goalent blue_blood_alley_target; authored-control.md § aiscripted_schedule, the 'Santa Monica hub, blueblood alley' row). StartSchedule 0x101a9b30 is ThinkSet(CineThink) at curtime; CineThink 0x101a8070 finds SMblueblood strictly inside the radius (FindEntity 0x101a7600) and possesses it (0x101a9790, then slot 586 on the target): the executor 0x101a98c0 resolves goalent, applies no forced state (forcestate 0), and for mode 1 calls ScheduledMoveToGoalEntity 0x102800c0: base schedule 2 IDLE_WALK through 0x10280de0, which slot 440 translates to SCHED_TROIKA_IDLE_PATROL 0x46 (TASK_PATROL_PATH 0; TASK_WAIT_FOR_MOVEMENT 0; TASK_WAIT_PVS 0; authored-control.md:313-319), m_pGoalEnt := the goal, and a type-4 navigator goal at the goal's origin, tolerance 128.0, activity ACT_WALK 9 (schedule-kernel.md § 0x102800c0). That SetGoal 0x102ecd20 builds the route and, the current task (TASK_PATROL_PATH 0x105, status new) not being a continuous move (slot 529: only 0x6e, 0x0b, 0x72), completes it through the navigator's slot 2 (0x102f1e2c..0x102f1e38 -> 0x102623c0 -> TaskComplete 0x10273e80): TASK_PATROL_PATH never starts (its start arm 0x102a594d does not run), so the trace shows its taskdone with no task event; MaintainSchedule then starts WAIT_FOR_MOVEMENT, which holds until the goal is reached; WAIT_PVS (Troika run arm 0x102aad7e) completes with the player in view; the program ends and SelectSchedule picks again. The order has no end of its own and no release (0x101a98c0 never resets). The three rows verbatim from sm_hub_1, SMblueblood (npc_VDialogPedestrian) anchored so the 25 m walk to the target crosses the arena clear of the cover block.
notes: Rows from $ELYSIUM_WORK_ROOT/exports_v2/_sidecars/sm_hub_1/sm_hub_1.ents: the director stands ~63 cm (25 units) from SMblueblood, inside its 128-unit radius; the target is (-1199.6, 2218.6) cm from SMblueblood. Nothing in the shipped game fires this director: SMblueblood's OnDialogEnd python bluebloodToAlley() carries the StartSchedule call commented out (santamonica.py:1833-1834) and no wire targets it. It is the corpus's only mode-1 (walk) row, so the record fires StartSchedule directly, as any wire could; it pins the executor's contract, not a hub defect. The schedule is installed before the goal (0x10280de0, then SetGoal), so OnScheduleChange's goal clear (0x102a0940) does not touch it.
